label: verify-q2-data

claims.claim: Independent-document pooled SD of Ki replicates is 0.61 pKi (95% CI [0.588, 0.637]), consistent with the literature 0.54
claims.source_says: results_Ki.json: inter_document sd 0.6122, ci95 [0.588, 0.637]. Kramer abstract: "a standard deviation of 0.54 pK(i) units".
claims.note: The 0.61 and CI reproduce exactly, but 0.54 lies outside that CI, so 'consistent' means 'similar', not statistically the same.

claims.claim: Between-target variance is only 8% (Ki) to 15% (IC50) of total in my 39-target ChEMBL set; target-only predictor r=0.28/0.38
claims.source_says: results_Ki.json: eta2_between 0.0771, r_LOO 0.2764; results_IC50.json: eta2_between 0.1470, r_LOO 0.3824. Decomposition n_targets_ge50: 35 (Ki), 38 (IC50).
claims.note: All numbers reproduce, but the decomposition used 35 and 38 targets (those with at least 50 pairs), not 39.

claims.claim: Noise ceiling on within-target Pearson r is about 0.87 (Ki) and 0.72 (IC50); pooled Ki R2 ceiling 0.77 vs Kramer 0.81
claims.source_says: Ki within_target_r_max 0.8665, pooled 0.8775 (squared 0.770); IC50 within_target_r_max 0.7199. Kramer: "maximum possible squared Pearson correlation coefficient (R(2)) on large data sets is estimated to be 0.81."
claims.note: All figures reproduce from the results files and Kramer's 0.81 is quoted correctly.

claims.claim: Mixed-assay noise is heavy-tailed (many pairs differ by more than 1 log), so SD-based ceilings are pessimistic relative to robust ones
claims.source_says: Landrum and Riniker: "almost 65% of the points differ by more than 0.3 log units, 27% differ by more than one log unit" (IC50, minimal curation). Own data: 16% (Ki), 23% (IC50) differ by more than 1 log.
claims.note: The paper supports a heavy tail but does not discuss SD versus robust ceilings; the 'pessimistic' step is the agent's own inference, and the 27% figure is for IC50 under minimal curation.

overall: The numbers reproduce from the local results files, and the Kramer and Landrum quotes are accurate. Two claims overreach: 0.54 sits outside the CI of 0.61, and the decomposition used 35 and 38 targets, not 39. The inference that SD-based ceilings are pessimistic is the agent's own, not the source's.
